package console

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/tucats/govax/internal/cpu"
	"github.com/tucats/govax/internal/rms"
)

func TestSurvey84(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("SURVEY_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("no SURVEY_OUT")
	}
	var sources []string
	for _, dir := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("SURVEY_DIRS"), ":") {
		s, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.for"))
		sources = append(sources, s...)
	}
	d, c, buf := shareFindConsole(t, false)
	summary, _ := os.Create(filepath.Join(out, "summary.txt"))
	defer summary.Close()
	fmt.Fprintln(summary, "name total main ftnrtl s0 p1 otherp0 dataReads dataWrites codeBytes")
	for _, source := range sources {
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(source), ".for")
		text, _ := os.ReadFile(source)
		upper := strings.ToUpper(name)
		c.ContainerSession.CreateRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA1:[000000]" + upper + ".FOR"}, rms.TextRecords, splitSource(string(text)))
		buf.Reset()
		okb := true
		for _, cmd := range []string{"FORTRAN ", "MACRO ", "LINK "} {
			if err := d.Dispatch(cmd + upper); err != nil || buf.Len() > 0 {
				fmt.Fprintf(summary, "%s BUILD-FAILED %s %v %q\n", name, cmd, err, firstLine(buf.String()))
				okb = false
				break
			}
		}
		if !okb {
			shareCleanup(d, upper)
			continue
		}
		recs, _, err := c.ContainerSession.ReadRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA1:[000000]" + upper + ".MAR"}, rms.TextRecords)
		if err == nil {
			var b bytes.Buffer
			for _, r := range recs {
				b.Write(r)
				b.WriteByte('\n')
			}
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".mar"), b.Bytes(), 0o644)
		}
		input, _ := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSuffix(source, ".for") + ".in")
		c.In = strings.NewReader(string(input))
		counts := map[uint32]int64{}
		names := map[uint32]string{}
		cpu.SurveyProfile = func(pc uint32, dec *cpu.Decoded) {
			if counts[pc] == 0 {
				names[pc] = dec.Instruction.Name
			}
			counts[pc]++
		}
		_, r0, w0, mr0, mw0 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
		got := shareRun(t, d, buf, upper)
		cpu.SurveyProfile = nil
		_, r1, w1, mr1, mw1 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
		want, werr := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSuffix(source, ".for") + ".out")
		if werr == nil && got != string(want) {
			fmt.Fprintf(summary, "# %s output differs\n", name)
		}
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".printed"), []byte(got), 0o644)

		var mainLo, mainHi, ftnLo, ftnHi uint32
		for _, icb := range c.ImageState(nil).ICBList {
			if icb.Name == "<MAIN>" {
				mainLo, mainHi = icb.Base, icb.End
			}
			if icb.Name == "FTNRTL" {
				ftnLo, ftnHi = icb.Base, icb.End
			}
		}
		var total, nmain, nftn, ns0, np1, nother int64
		byOp := map[string]int64{}
		type hot struct {
			pc uint32
			n  int64
		}
		var hots []hot
		for pc, n := range counts {
			total += n
			switch {
			case pc >= mainLo && pc < mainHi:
				nmain += n
				byOp[names[pc]] += n
				hots = append(hots, hot{pc, n})
			case pc >= ftnLo && pc < ftnHi:
				nftn += n
			case pc >= 0x80000000:
				ns0 += n
			case pc >= 0x40000000:
				np1 += n
			default:
				nother += n
			}
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(summary, name, total, nmain, nftn, ns0, np1, nother, r1-r0+mr1-mr0, w1-w0+mw1-mw0, mainHi-mainLo)
		var ops []string
		for k := range byOp {
			ops = append(ops, k)
		}
		sort.Slice(ops, func(i, j int) bool { return byOp[ops[i]] > byOp[ops[j]] })
		var rep bytes.Buffer
		fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "%s total=%d main=%d ftnrtl=%d s0=%d\nby opcode (main image):\n", name, total, nmain, nftn, ns0)
		for _, k := range ops {
			fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "  %-10s %12d %5.1f%%\n", k, byOp[k], 100*float64(byOp[k])/float64(max(nmain, 1)))
		}
		sort.Slice(hots, func(i, j int) bool { return hots[i].n > hots[j].n })
		buf.Reset()
		c.In = strings.NewReader(string(input))
		d.Dispatch("RUN/NOEXECUTE " + upper)
		buf.Reset()
		fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "hot PCs (main image):\n")
		for i, h := range hots {
			if i == 40 {
				break
			}
			buf.Reset()
			c.Disassemble(h.pc, h.pc)
			fmt.Fprintf(&rep, "%10d  %08X %s\n", h.n, h.pc, strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()))
		}
		buf.Reset()
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".prof"), rep.Bytes(), 0o644)
		shareCleanup(d, upper)
	}
}

func firstLine(s string) string {
	s, _, _ = strings.Cut(s, "\n")
	return s
}

func shareCleanup(d *Dispatcher, upper string) {
	d.Dispatch("DELETE " + upper + ".*;*")
}

func TestSurvey84Hand(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("SURVEY_OUT")
	d, c, buf := shareFindConsole(t, false)
	for _, dir := range strings.Split(os.Getenv("SURVEY_DIRS"), ":") {
		files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.mar"))
		for _, f := range files {
			name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(f), ".mar")
			u := strings.ToUpper(name)
			text, _ := os.ReadFile(f)
			c.ContainerSession.CreateRecordFile(rms.FileLocation{Name: "DUA1:[000000]" + u + ".MAR"}, rms.TextRecords, splitSource(string(text)))
			buf.Reset()
			for _, cmd := range []string{"MACRO ", "LINK "} {
				if err := d.Dispatch(cmd + u); err != nil || buf.Len() > 0 {
					fmt.Printf("%s %s: %v %.300s\n", cmd, u, err, buf.String())
				}
			}
			var total int64
			cpu.SurveyProfile = func(pc uint32, dec *cpu.Decoded) { total++ }
			_, r0, w0, mr0, mw0 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
			got := shareRun(t, d, buf, u)
			cpu.SurveyProfile = nil
			_, r1, w1, mr1, mw1 := c.Engine.Memory().Stats()
			var code uint32
			for _, icb := range c.ImageState(nil).ICBList {
				if icb.Name == "<MAIN>" {
					code = icb.End - icb.Base
				}
			}
			fmt.Printf("%s total=%d reads=%d writes=%d code=%d printed=%q\n", name, total, r1-r0+mr1-mr0, w1-w0+mw1-mw0, code, strings.TrimSpace(firstLine(got)))
			_ = out
			shareCleanup(d, u)
		}
	}
}
